task: ae.hm Hindley-Milner type inference for a tiny functional language
reasoning_summary: Algorithm W with one mutable substitution, an occurs check, generalisation over variables not free in the environment and monomorphic let rec. Tests combine known principal types and exact error positions with a type-directed random term generator checked by independent oracles (instance matcher, let-inlining, print/parse round trip, +1 mismatch) and two mutation kill checks. The only debug attempt fixed a test-generator bug (unparenthesised let/if in argument positions).
